title: Bernoulli subset mass and Shapley weight
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$ with $k\le n$, \[\int_0^1 p^k(1-p)^{n-k}\,dp=\frac{1}{(n+1)\binom{n}{k}},\] where $\binom{n}{k}$ is the binomial coefficient.
